name: reviewer
description: Generates a repository-specific merge-request review pipeline in `.reviewer/`: surveys where the code is fragile, lets you pick reviewers from a 28-entry catalog, and writes coordinator, reviewer and judge briefs grounded in verified paths and the team's own conventions. Commands: :init (create), :review (local dry run), :add-agent (extend), :sync (realign). It builds reviewers rather than reviewing code itself.
